notes.title: Christmas Update - Guided Mode Now Available
notes.content:
-Difficulty settings available in main menu (Guided / Realistic)
-Guided mode includes new gameplay mechanics that allow the player to more easily understand where to go and what to do
-Guided mode includes an objectives menu any time a player pauses
-Certain items or enemies can be seen through walls in guided mode
-The new difficulty setting also decreases the number and speed of enemies
-Player is faster in 2D levels
-Minor bug fixes
-More secrets

notes.title: Patch Notes August 11, 2024
notes.content:
-Fixed major issue where player could not interact with the pause menu
-Fixed major issue where screen resolution would change after death
-Added motion blur option to the settings in the main menu
-Changed textures in introduction level
-Added an indicator to make the small hallway in Backrooms level more obvious
-Fixed lighting in the second stage of the School level so it is easier to see where to go
-Changed fonts in Test level
-Other minor bug fixes
